camel_example: aliyun amqp-open CreateQueue --region cn-hangzhou --InstanceId 'amqp-cn-v0h1kb9nu***' --VirtualHost test --QueueName DemoQueue
description_en: Creates a queue. A queue is an MSMQ. In ApsaraMQ for RabbitMQ, you send messages to a specified exchange, and then the exchange performs routing to attach the messages to a queue
description_zh: Queue是指消息队列，云消息队列 RabbitMQ 版的消息都会被发送至指定的Exchange，再由Exchange路由至绑定的Queue中
kebab_example: aliyun amqp-open create-queue --instance-id 'amqp-cn-v0h1kb9nu***' --virtual-host test --queue-name DemoQueue --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateQueue

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the ApsaraMQ for RabbitMQ (MSMQ) instance to which the queue belongs
parameters.help_zh: 待创建Queue所属的云消息队列 RabbitMQ 版实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the vhost to which the queue belongs.
The name can contain only letters, digits, hyphens (-), underscores (_), periods (.), number signs (#), forward slashes (/), and at signs (@). The name must be 1 to 255 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
待创建Queue所属的Vhost名称。
只能包含字⺟、数字、短划线（-）、下划线（_）、半角句号（.）、井号（#）、正斜线（/）、at符号（@），⻓度限制1~255字符
parameters.name: virtual_host

parameters.help_en:
The name of the queue.

The name can contain only letters, digits, hyphens (-), underscores (_), periods (.), number signs (#), forward slashes (/), and at signs (@). The name must be 1 to 255 characters in length.

After a queue is created, its name cannot be modified. You must delete the queue and create a new one to change the name
parameters.help_zh:
待创建的Queue的名称。

Queue名称只能包含字母、数字、短划线（-）、下划线（_）、半角句号（.）、井号（#）、正斜线（/）、at符号（@），长度限制1~255字符。

Queue创建后，名称无法修改，只能删除后重建
parameters.name: queue_name

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to automatically delete the queue. Valid values:

true: yes. If the last consumer that subscribes to the queue unsubscribes from the queue, the queue is automatically deleted.
false: no
parameters.help_zh:
是否自动删除。取值：

true：是。如果订阅该Queue的最后一个消费端取消订阅后，那么该Queue将会自动删除。
false：否
parameters.name: auto_delete_state

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the exchange is exclusive. Valid values:
true: Yes. The exchange can be used only by the connection that declared it. The exchange is automatically deleted after the connection is closed.
false: No
parameters.help_zh:
是否为排他性Exchange。取值：

true：是。只能被声明该排他性Exchange的Connection使用。该Connection断开后该排他性Exchange自动删除。
false：否
parameters.name: exclusive_state

parameters.help_en:
The time-to-live (TTL) of messages in the queue.

A message expires when its retention time in the queue exceeds the configured TTL.

The TTL must be a non-negative integer. The maximum TTL is 1 day. Unit: milliseconds. For example, if the TTL of a message is set to 1000, the message remains in the queue for up to 1 second
parameters.help_zh:
消息在Queue中的有效期。

某条消息在Queue中的留存时间超过配置的消息存活时间时，则该消息过期。

消息存活时间的值必须为非负整型数，最大为1天。单位为毫秒。例如，某条消息的存活时间的值是1000，则代表该消息最多会在Queue中存活1秒
parameters.name: message_ttl

parameters.help_en:
The automatic expiration time of the queue. If the queue is not accessed within the specified time, it is automatically deleted.

Unit: milliseconds.
To use the feature corresponding to this parameter, you must activate it first. To activate the feature, <props="china">submit a ticket (https://selfservice.console.aliyun.com/ticket/createIndex)</props><props="intl">submit a ticket (https://ticket-intl.console.aliyun.com/#/ticket/createIndex)</props>
parameters.help_zh:
Queue的自动过期时间。如果Queue在指定时间内没有被访问，则会被自动删除。

单位为毫秒。
该参数对应的功能需要开通后才能使用。如需使用，请<props="china">提交工单 (https://selfservice.console.aliyun.com/ticket/createIndex)</props><props="intl">提交工单 (https://ticket-intl.console.aliyun.com/#/ticket/createIndex)</props>开通
parameters.name: auto_expire_state

parameters.help_en:
This parameter is not supported in the current version.

The maximum number of messages in the queue. If the number of messages exceeds this value, the earliest messages in the queue are deleted
parameters.help_zh:
当前版本不支持该参数。

Queue中消息的最大数量。如果超出该数量，则先到达该Queue的消息将会被删除
parameters.name: max_length

parameters.help_en:
The dead-letter exchange. This type of exchange is used to accept messages that consumers deny.

If a consumer chooses to deny a message without requesting to send it again, ApsaraMQ for RabbitMQ (MSMQ) performs routing of the message to the specified dead-letter exchange. The exchange then performs routing to attach the message to a queue for row store
parameters.help_zh:
死信Exchange。该类Exchange是用来接收被拒绝的消息。

如果消费端拒绝一个不重新发送的消息，那么消息队列RabbitMQ版将会把消息路由到指定的死信Exchange，该Exchange再将消息路由到绑定的Queue进行存储
parameters.name: dead_letter_exchange

parameters.help_en:
The dead-letter routing key.
The routing key can contain only letters, digits, hyphens (-), underscores (_), periods (.), number signs (#), forward slashes (/), and at signs (@). The routing key must be 1 to 255 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
死信Routing Key。
只能包含字⺟、数字、短划线（-）、下划线（_）、半角句号（.）、井号（#）、正斜线（/）、at符号（@），⻓度限制1~255字符
parameters.name: dead_letter_routing_key

parameters.help_en:
The priority of the queue. Recommended values: 1 to 10.
This parameter is used for message priorities and is supported only by exclusive instances. To use this feature, you must activate it first. To activate the feature, <props="china">submit a ticket (https://selfservice.console.aliyun.com/ticket/createIndex)</props><props="intl">submit a ticket (https://ticket-intl.console.aliyun.com/#/ticket/createIndex)</props>
parameters.help_zh:
队列优先级，推荐取值范围（1~10）。
该参数为消息优先级对应参数，仅独享实例支持，开通消息优先级功能后才能使用。如需使用，请<props="china">提交工单 (https://selfservice.console.aliyun.com/ticket/createIndex)</props><props="intl">提交工单 (https://ticket-intl.console.aliyun.com/#/ticket/createIndex)</props>开通
parameters.name: maximum_priority
